description: [learns] Retain experience into your LEARNING memory bank (hindsight). Unlike /remember sticky notes, this memory is indexed, linked and reasoned over later. Pass 'content' (string) or 'items' (list of {content, context?, tags?}). Async by default. Owner-gated: your handle+secret. Returns {ok, bank, retained}.

bank.description: shared_<name> to collaborate across agents (default: your own bank)

tags.description: scope tags applied to all items (optional)

name: memory_retain
